title: 海風蘇格蘭浮式風場
summary: 以spar 支撐、繫泊與浮式經驗遷移解析海風蘇格蘭浮式風場：六個原理與架構單元、十二項可保存的分析及驗證作業，附假想量化例、來源及衍生工程比較。
summaryEn: Explore Hywind Scotland Floating Wind Farm through spar supports, mooring and floating-design transfer: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.
scope: 和平民用發電與融合研究的公開熱循環、功能架構及工程證據。核能不包含燃料製備、濃縮、武器、反應性整定或反應爐操作；地熱、風電及水力不提供未經場址驗證的施工／操作參數。算例皆是假想，實機由合格專業團隊依規範負責。
scopeEn: Public thermal cycles, functional architecture and engineering evidence for peaceful generation/fusion research. Nuclear content excludes fuel production, enrichment, weapons, reactivity settings and reactor operations. Geothermal/wind/hydro supply no unverified construction/operation settings. Examples are hypothetical; qualified professionals govern actual equipment.

stages.title: 系統邊界與基本原理
stages.description: 在海風蘇格蘭浮式風場案例中比較Scotland風分佈與海上rotor載荷，各完成分析及驗證。
stages.descriptionEn: Analyze and validate scotland wind distribution and offshore rotor loads within the Hywind Scotland Floating Wind Farm case.

steps.title: 風資源與功率包絡：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Wind resources and power envelopes: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對Scotland風分佈提出可反駁的風資源與功率包絡模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable wind resources and power envelopes model and evidence record for scotland wind distribution.
steps.instruction: 在「海風蘇格蘭浮式風場」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識Scotland風分佈。可用風功率隨風速立方變化；風輪效率、額定及停機區間限制輸出。 建立風資源與功率包絡的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是spar 支撐、繫泊與浮式經驗遷移。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。把風速分佈與假想功率曲線積分爲年能量。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify scotland wind distribution in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Hywind Scotland Floating Wind Farm. Available power scales cubically with speed; rotor efficiency, rating and shutdown regions limit output. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of wind resources and power envelopes, focusing on spar supports, mooring and floating-design transfer. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Integrate a wind distribution with an assumed curve for annual energy. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 把風速分佈與假想功率曲線積分爲年能量。
steps.observationEn: Integrate a wind distribution with an assumed curve for annual energy.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：額定MW乘8760h就是實際年發電量。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Rated MW times 8760 hours equals actual annual generation.
steps.check: 提交Scotland風分佈的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for scotland wind distribution.

knowledge.title: 風資源與功率包絡
knowledge.text: 可用風功率隨風速立方變化；風輪效率、額定及停機區間限制輸出。 本課架構對應：Scotland風分佈
knowledge.textEn: Available power scales cubically with speed; rotor efficiency, rating and shutdown regions limit output. Course architecture correspondence: Scotland wind distribution

knowledge.title: 獨立驗證與失效邊界
knowledge.text: 把風速分佈與假想功率曲線積分爲年能量。 應逐項保留基準與不確定度；額定MW乘8760h就是實際年發電量。 是本單元要排除的誤解。
knowledge.textEn: Integrate a wind distribution with an assumed curve for annual energy. Retain each reference and uncertainty; reject the misconception: Rated MW times 8760 hours equals actual annual generation.

knowledge.title: 原創假想量化練習
knowledge.text: 教學小型風輪假設ρ=1.225 kg/m³、面積90 m²、風速10 m/s、Cp=0.40，P=0.5ρAv³Cp=22.0500 kW。未含傳動電損、尾流、額定限值與風速分佈，不是本工程產品數值。
knowledge.textEn: Assume a teaching rotor with rho=1.225 kg/m³, A=90 m², v=10 m/s and Cp=0.40: P=22.0500 kW. Drivetrain/electrical loss, wakes, ratings and wind distributions are excluded; these are not project specifications.

quiz.question: 就Scotland風分佈的「風資源與功率包絡」，哪個推論或驗證成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which inference or check is justified for wind resources and power envelopes in scotland wind distribution?
options: 可用風功率隨風速立方變化；風輪效率、額定及停機區間限制輸出。
額定MW乘8760h就是實際年發電量。
兩個案例的平均相同，就足以排除空間、時間及模型誤差。
optionsEn: Available power scales cubically with speed; rotor efficiency, rating and shutdown regions limit output.
Rated MW times 8760 hours equals actual annual generation.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.
quiz.explanation: 可用風功率隨風速立方變化；風輪效率、額定及停機區間限制輸出。 把風速分佈與假想功率曲線積分爲年能量。
quiz.explanationEn: Available power scales cubically with speed; rotor efficiency, rating and shutdown regions limit output. Integrate a wind distribution with an assumed curve for annual energy.

steps.title: 風資源與功率包絡：證據驗證
steps.titleEn: Wind resources and power envelopes: evidence validation
steps.objective: 針對Scotland風分佈提出可反駁的風資源與功率包絡模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable wind resources and power envelopes model and evidence record for scotland wind distribution.
steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「風資源與功率包絡」模型，檢查Scotland風分佈的兩個假想案例。把風速分佈與假想功率曲線積分爲年能量。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分可用風功率隨風速立方變化；風輪效率、額定及停機區間限制輸出。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous wind resources and power envelopes model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving scotland wind distribution. Integrate a wind distribution with an assumed curve for annual energy. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Available power scales cubically with speed; rotor efficiency, rating and shutdown regions limit output." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.
steps.observation: 把風速分佈與假想功率曲線積分爲年能量。
steps.observationEn: Integrate a wind distribution with an assumed curve for annual energy.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：額定MW乘8760h就是實際年發電量。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Rated MW times 8760 hours equals actual annual generation.
steps.check: 提交Scotland風分佈的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for scotland wind distribution.

steps.title: 葉片氣動與載荷：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Blade aerodynamics and loads: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對海上rotor載荷提出可反駁的葉片氣動與載荷模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable blade aerodynamics and loads model and evidence record for offshore rotor loads.
steps.instruction: 在「海風蘇格蘭浮式風場」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識海上rotor載荷。扭轉、弦長與來流角共同影響升阻；輸出最優與疲勞最小未必同點。 建立葉片氣動與載荷的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是spar 支撐、繫泊與浮式經驗遷移。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較兩組假想葉素的力與力矩方向。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify offshore rotor loads in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Hywind Scotland Floating Wind Farm. Twist, chord and inflow set lift/drag; maximum output and minimum fatigue need not coincide. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of blade aerodynamics and loads, focusing on spar supports, mooring and floating-design transfer. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare force/moment directions for two assumed blade elements. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 比較兩組假想葉素的力與力矩方向。
steps.observationEn: Compare force/moment directions for two assumed blade elements.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：提升瞬時功率必然減輕所有結構載荷。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: More instantaneous power reduces every structural load.
steps.check: 提交海上rotor載荷的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for offshore rotor loads.

optionsEn: More instantaneous power reduces every structural load.

quiz.explanationEn: Twist, chord and inflow set lift/drag; maximum output and minimum fatigue need not coincide. Compare force/moment directions for two assumed blade elements.
